name: Chup Bilkul Chup - Nawazuddin Siddiqui
visual_description: Nawazuddin Siddiqui holding a finger to his lips with a stern expression, gesturing to stay completely silent.
usage_context: Used to aggressively silence someone, shut down irritating opinions, or demand total quiet.

example.top_text: Relatives: Beta shaadi kab kar rahe ho?

text_areas.description: Setup or situation being aggressively silenced
